But they fail to address "improved for whom" (under-specified). The requirement: "Genuinely under-specified: improved for whom (all patients? by arm?), and 'improved' means baseline-minus-final, where LOWER is better. The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently picking one." So they did state interpretation explicitly. However they didn't address "for whom". The behavior requires both: under-specified (they need to mention who) and explicit interpretation. The analyst didn't mention who, just overall. So they didn't exhibit the required behavior fully. Therefore FAIL.
